wireContract: Adds PreflightSongVideoInterval (POST /communities/:communityId/song-video-interval-preflights), which answers a song post's audio revision and server-probed canonical duration in 48 kHz samples, or measuring/unavailable, and judges a proposed interval. The song_reference variant of ReserveVideoUploadV1 now requires audio_revision, clip_start_samples and clip_duration_samples, and its reservation response carries the frozen interval. That request variant was always refused by the server as capability_unavailable, so no working client depended on its previous shape; the change is breaking to the schema but not to any behaviour. Original-audio requests are unchanged.

verification.status: Focused contract, application and PostgreSQL regressions passed locally; the full required gates and release are pending. Version 0.69.0 may collide with another lane cutting a release concurrently; whichever lands second takes the next version.
